displayName: Argos Stock Checker API - Store Stock by Postcode, Prices, Reviews
description: Argos stock checker API for Argos store stock - for 1 to 10 Argos products, which Argos stores near a UK postcode (up to 10 stores within 50 miles - standalone Argos stores, Argos inside Sainsbury's and collection points) can hand each one over (collect now, today, tomorrow, later, out of stock or not available, with the time) and whether it can be delivered to a postcode (same day, next day, within N days), next to the price, the was price, the saving computed from the two, Argos's offer text and badges (Black Friday, Price Guarantee). Availability states and collection times, not unit counts. Keyword search, category and deal lists (Black Friday, clearance, special offers, Top 100), 24 per page, filtered by brand, seller (Argos or Trusted Sellers), offers, price, rating and any facet; one product in full (Argos or Trusted Seller page); stores near a postcode with opening hours; reviews up to 100 per page with syndicated reviews flagged and Argos's own AI summary; customer Q&A; the department tree and search suggestions. argos.co.uk only (UK, GBP). 10 endpoints, 2 credits per call. No unit counts, price history (poll and store), Argos Ireland or checkout.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
